title: QV_2x4_02: SK-B1 + CV3-B1: the 16 B=1 family circuits + the 4 B=1 k = 5 circuits, sampled (prompts/36 section 4)

criteria.name: K1 every sampled circuit: max abs(dpsi) < 1e-10 (phase removed, on the codeword amplitudes) and leakage < 1e-9 against krylov.coarse_states (save_amplitudes route; a failure is a STOP)
K2 per-state test on the full sequence (|n/N - p| <= 5 sigma for p >= 1e-3), 0 failures; fraction outside the exact support 0; rejected 0
K3 decoder round trip: every accepted state re-encodes to its string (0 mismatches)
K0 the prefix segments rebuild the counts of the first L outcomes at every prefix L (prompts/36a R15 (iii))
M measure_sampling true on every sampled run (Aer metadata; false would re-simulate per shot: STOP the design)
S1 the run happened on the GPU
S2 wall <= min(walltime, 3600 s) and <= 1.1 x predicted + 120 s
S3 policy telemetry non-null (wall, phases, GPUs, s per circuit, s per shot, peak GPU MiB, mean utilisation)
S4 every seed recorded (chunk_seed(s0, circuit index, 0, shots))
S6 shots >= the part's shots on every sampled run

run.engine: AerSimulator statevector double, device GPU, cuStateVec

part.content: SK-B1 + CV3-B1: the 16 B=1 family circuits + the 4 B=1 k = 5 circuits, sampled
part.seed_rule: aer seed of chunk i of circuit c = s0 * 1e4 + c * 1e6 + i * stride, stride = chunk size, s0 = 33 000 000 + 1e5 x token index (prompts/33 2.3 s0; the circuit/chunk offsets are widened from 1e3 c so that circuits, chunks, tokens and the a/b halves are disjoint for <= 1e6 shots per circuit: the literal s0 + 1e3 c + i stride overlaps above 1000 shots per circuit).  prompts/33b R4: every part of a split class-4 run (part 1 on the F token, parts >= 2 on any C4_PART slot) uses s0 of the run's OWN F token, i = the chunk's index in the UNSPLIT chunk plan and stride = the sizing's chunk, so the parts concatenate to the unsplit run seed for seed and a slot can be re-used; the run's CV3 equal-shots sample uses the same s0 with circuit offsets 100 (k <= 4) / 200 (k = 5); an f-cell slot uses the slot's own s0 with circuit offset 4 x the cell's global index

data.segments_rule: per run, `segments` tile [0, shots) in shot order with boundaries at every prefix length, at shots - uniform_shots and at shots; counts at a prefix L = the sum of the segments that end at or before L; the last `uniform_shots` are the uniform 2e5-per-sector block
